name: MGS Recommend to a Friend
author: MD MONIRUZZAMAN

sections.description:
MGS Recommend to a Friend is a WordPress Plugin for recommending any link/URL to a friend.

Easily add a recommendation form with a floating modal. Allow users to share links, tell a friend via email, and boost your website referral traffic.

The MGS Recommend to a Friend plugin can be simply integrated into your website with plugin settings and a shortcode. It looks great with all types of devices. Try out the demo.

LIVE DEMO | GO PRO 🚀

FEATURES

  • Extremely easy Configuration
  • Display a Floating Button to open a Modal Recommendation Form using Shortcode
  • Font Awesome Icons
  • Ajax Request Form Process
  • Friend will receive an email with sender information and the recommended URL (recommended web page URL)
  • Get the IP of the sender inside the email body
  • GDPR ready (Consent checkbox Field settings included)
  • 100% Responsive and Mobile-Friendly Layout
  • Dedicated Support
  • and Much More!

Configuration Settings Included
* Options for email Template
* Options for Recommendation Form Fields
* Options for Consent (Name, Text, URL) checkbox

⚡️ PRO FEATURES

  • Includes all Free version features
  • Anti Spam Captcha Configuration:
    • Math Captcha
    • Google reCaptcha
    • Disable Captcha
  • Floating Button Horizontal Position Options:
    • Left
    • Right
  • Advanced Configuration Options Included:
    • Floating button bottom margin option
    • Form and floating button background color options
    • Floating button tooltip text option
    • Floating button tooltip text display option
    • Admin notification configuration options
    • Email template for admin notification emails
    • Send button background color option
sections.installation:
1. Install MGS Recommend to a Friend plugin either via the WordPress.org plugin repository or by uploading the files to your server.
  2. Activate MGS Recommend to a Friend plugin.
  3. Navigate to the Settings page of MGS Recommend to a Friend plugin and configure the settings according to your needs.
sections.faq:
I have issues with settings. How can I get support?

Feel free to create a topic.

What are the differences between Lite & Pro version?

MGS Recommend to a Friend Pro comes with advanced features including Anti Spam Captcha, Floating Button Horizontal Position, Admin Notification email, Color Settings Option, Tooltip Text Settings Option and so on.

Is that a one-time payment for MGS Recommend to a Friend Pro?

Yes, you pay once to get lifetime updates.
